label: armament
question: Among the dated events in the timeline from the mid-1950s onward, list the occasions when the fort's anti-aircraft guns or missile sites were replaced or converted to a new system, in chronological order.
why_needs_multiple: Hai lần thay thế hoặc chuyển đổi hệ thống phòng không ở hai thời điểm khác nhau.
criterion: The fort's anti-aircraft guns or missile sites were replaced by, or converted to, a new system.

question: Among the dated events in the timeline from the late 1950s onward, list the occasions when a military unit, battery, reserve post or site stopped being stationed, headquartered or active at the fort, in chronological order (items from the same year in any order).
why_needs_multiple: Ba lần kết thúc hiện diện ở các đơn vị khác nhau; mốc thứ hai là approximate_date nên được khai trong flagged_ids.
criterion: A military unit, battery, reserve post or site stops being stationed, headquartered or active at the fort.
